proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ A hA hI
  have h0 : ∑' n, P (A n) ≠ ⊤ → P (Filter.limsup A Filter.atTop) = 0 := MeasureTheory.measure_limsup_atTop_eq_zero
  have h1 : ∑' n, P (A n) = ⊤ → P (Filter.limsup A Filter.atTop) = 1 := ProbabilityTheory.measure_limsup_eq_one hA hI
  constructor
  · refine ⟨fun h hs => ?_, h0⟩
    rw [h1 hs] at h; exact one_ne_zero h
  · refine ⟨fun h => ?_, h1⟩
    by_contra hs
    rw [h0 hs] at h; exact zero_ne_one h
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (A : ℕ → Set Ω), (∀ n, MeasurableSet (A n)) → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepSet A P → (P (Filter.limsup A Filter.atTop) = 0 ↔ ∑' n, P (A n) ≠ ⊤) ∧ (P (Filter.limsup A Filter.atTop) = 1 ↔ ∑' n, P (A n) = ⊤)
